outcome: COMPLETED — Display centres the three-dimensional focus on the screen and accepts owner-offered photographic contacts at their actual projected extent. Each owner keeps its realized content and its declared UI rectangles.

witness.centroid_native: The ordinary field suite exercised rotated root → child w → root with perspective and orthographic lenses on both native field transports, at 390 × 844 and 1280 × 800. It projected the mean of the four 3D vertices through the actual model, view and projection matrices before dividing by homogeneous depth, checked the shared contact projection away from the centre, and compared the declared UI rectangle with the independently centred camera extent. The prior renderer failed the asymmetric-viewport case.

centroid_browser.carrier: Chromium Canvas2D, local full public site with only the candidate field script substituted. A matched original site supplied the comparison.
centroid_browser.cases: At 1200 × 800 and 390 × 844 each, measured the six actual site roots (Philosophy, Papers, Schattenseiten, Datenschutz, Impressum and Crawlerbait), then Philosophy at local w and after rotating that focus. All 16 candidate observations placed the projected 3D focus exactly at the viewport centre, with unchanged walked addresses and grid rectangles and zero reported field/layer errors.
centroid_browser.before: At 1200 × 800 the original root centres on Philosophy, Schattenseiten and Crawlerbait were 75 CSS px right and 50 CSS px down; at 390 × 844 Schattenseiten and Crawlerbait were 24.375 CSS px left and 52.75 CSS px down. Papers and the two legal sites were already centred in both carriers. These are readouts of the geometric relation.

owner_contacts_native: An owner offering its own destinations can suppress the four decorative support-cell labels.
Clicking blank support selects no point and leaves the walked container at its root.
Disabling generic point ink removes its glyphs on both transports.
An off-centre hit within overlapping, differently sized offered tetrahedra selects the front print; the native fixture uses an offset of 26 CSS px and retains the local root.

schattenseiten_browser.carrier: Ordinary local Chromium, desktop mouse at 1280 × 800 and emulated touch at 390 × 844 with Canvas2D. The phone touch case also ran in Chromium WebGL2 with SwiftShader.
schattenseiten_browser.work: At zxz, a contact 0.32 tile widths across and 0.17 tile heights down from the projected tile centre selected work:02001, opening whole work → The first seven images → Cluster 1 → 02001.
schattenseiten_browser.cluster: The corresponding off-centre contact at wyw selected cluster:1 and opened Cluster 1 with its seven works. Offset distances measured 13.87 CSS px on desktop and 5.49 on phone.
schattenseiten_browser.blank: A contact at zww in the unused upper row retained whole work with no selected point and no shared field descent.

context.boundary: Display owns projection and contact transport. Schattenseiten owns the images, cluster identities and reading sequence. The authored compass layout remains a separate open Display nutrient. The witnesses cover the stated local Chromium, native and software-WebGL cases. Physical handset, hardware-GPU timing, universal artwork occlusion, integrated publication and live deployment require their own evidence.
